attr_list.get_cmd: bcmcmd 'pciephy fw version' | grep 'PCIe FW version' | cut -d ' ' -f 4
bcmcmd 'pciephy fw version' | grep 'PCIe FW loader version' | cut -d ' ' -f 5

mkdir -p /mnt/onie-boot && mount LABEL=ONIE-BOOT /mnt/onie-boot &> /dev/null; if [ -f "/mnt/onie-boot/onie/update/update_details.log" ]; then ver=$(grep -i 'Updater version:' "/mnt/onie-boot/onie/update/update_details.log" | tail -1 | awk '{print $3}' | tr -d '\r\n'); if [ -n "$ver" ]; then result=$(/mnt/onie-boot/onie/tools/bin/onie-fwpkg | grep "$ver" | awk -F'|' '{print $3}' | tail -1 | xargs | tr -d '\r\n'); echo "$ver ($result)"; else echo "NA ()"; fi; else echo "NA ()"; fi

attr_list.bmc_cmd: _rv=$(ipmitool fru print 1 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' ' | cut -d' ' -f3-5 | grep 'Manufacturer') && echo $_rv || echo 'Manufacturer : N/A'
_rv=$(ipmitool fru print 1 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' ' | cut -d' ' -f3-5 | grep 'Name') && echo $_rv || echo 'Name : N/A'
_rv=$(ipmitool fru print 1 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' ' | cut -d' ' -f3-5 | grep 'Serial') && echo $_rv || echo 'Serial : N/A'
_rv=$(ipmitool fru print 2 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' ' | cut -d' ' -f3-5 | grep 'Manufacturer') && echo $_rv || echo 'Manufacturer : N/A'
_rv=$(ipmitool fru print 2 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' ' | cut -d' ' -f3-5 | grep 'Name') && echo $_rv || echo 'Name : N/A'
_rv=$(ipmitool fru print 2 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' ' | cut -d' ' -f3-5 | grep 'Serial') && echo $_rv || echo 'Serial : N/A'
